ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio of high-intensity white pixels (~10%) to low-intensity black pixels (~90%) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast white annular blobs (rosettes) distributed across the predominantly black fluke surface, with higher spatial density observed on the right lobe and distal edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees and significant bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the continuous trailing edge boundary, featuring sharp pixel-amplitude peaks and irregular valleys isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosette-shaped scars) distributed across the entire ventral fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy colonization of acorn barnacles (coronulids) forming high-relief, high-contrast clusters at the distal tips and along the lateral edges of the fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Combination of extreme peripheral serration and dense rosette scarring across a near-total black base pigmentation.
